email_body:
Dear EFA Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Assistant internship at EFA. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content creation, and a strong interest in health advocacy, I am eager to contribute to EFA’s mission of putting patients at the heart of policy decisions.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage social media accounts, draft and edit content, create visuals with Canva, and maintain websites on WordPress. I have experience in drafting newsletters, analysing social media insights and website analytics, and ensuring brand consistency across materials. My work with healthcare-related projects, such as the ViviDoctor web application and the pharmacists' association site, has given me insight into the health sector.

I am fluent in English, have a good eye for design, and am proactive and organised. I thrive in international teams and am keen to learn and grow within EFA’s communications team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support EFA’s communications work.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear EFA Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications Assistant internship at the European Federation of Allergy and Airways Diseases Patients' Associations (EFA). As a digital marketer with a technical background and a passion for health advocacy, I am drawn to EFA’s commitment to ensuring that patients are at the heart of policy decisions. I believe my skills in social media management, content creation, and website maintenance align well with the tasks outlined in the internship.

In my current freelance work and my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in managing social media accounts, drafting and editing content, creating visuals with Canva, and maintaining websites on WordPress. I have also supported the creation of newsletters and ad hoc mailings, analysed social media insights and website analytics, and ensured that all communications materials adhere to branding guidelines. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical SEO audits that measurably improved search visibility. Additionally, I have worked on healthcare-related projects, such as front-end development for a healthcare web application and building a website for a pharmacists' association, which has given me a foundational understanding of the health sector.

I am fluent in English, have a good eye for design, and am highly organised. I am comfortable working in a small, international team and am proactive in taking on new challenges. I am particularly interested in developing my skills in project and policy-related communications and in contributing to EFA’s workplan for 2027.

I am eager to bring my mix of digital marketing and technical skills to EFA and to learn from your communications team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support EFA’s communications activities.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Experience in drafting written content in English and creating layouts for publications, articles, and brochures, with a good eye for design.
• Proficient in managing social media accounts, including drafting posts, creating visuals with Canva, and analysing trends.
• Skilled in website content management and maintenance using WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS tools, including content migration and page layout creation.
• Strong analytical skills, with experience in collecting and analysing indicators on the impact of communications activities using Google Analytics, Search Console, and social media insights.
• Experience in healthcare-related projects, including front-end development for a healthcare web application and building a website for a pharmacists' association, demonstrating an interest in health policy.
